description: Open the project editor (the app's openProjectEditor): loads the config into the editor store, then opens /project/edit?firmwareId=<id> either in a new app window (default, via the app's createWindowWithPath) or by navigating the current window. MUTATING (loads config, opens window).

target.description: "new" opens a separate editor window (app default); "current" navigates the main window.

name: project_open_editor
title: Open project editor window
